note: Four builders fixed the exact measured defects from round 2. Juice made the biggest gain of the project so far (+18) and cut faces crossed 60. But two things went wrong and both are worth recording. First, materials REGRESSED (-3): the builder dropped the flesh albedo exactly as instructed, and the stage builder simultaneously raised the key light from 6.2 to 7.7 and lifted environmentIntensity — the two changes cancelled, and the red channel still clips across half the cut face. That is a coordination failure between agents editing different files, not a failure of either agent. Second, the juice central test still fails for a reason nobody predicted: a single speed-INDEPENDENT particle class (cling beads) owns 68% of the fast frame's pixels and drags its statistics back to the slow case, even though every speed-dependent class was fixed correctly.
